doctor_hint: Local diagnosis makes no external requests or installations. Only explicit tests check live operations.
load_error: Could not load settings. Try Check configuration again.
report_error: Could not copy the diagnosis. Try again.
pending_hint: Automated access is pending. This switch does not bypass review; import evidence you are authorized to provide.
providers_hint: Keys stay encrypted on this device. Enable usage explicitly to authorize spending. Leave a key blank to keep it.
key_replace: Leave blank to keep the stored key
routing_hint: Automatic search uses the first enabled provider with a key, otherwise public search. Free search never uses paid providers. A selected paid provider never silently switches to another.
budget_hint: Estimated costs are reserved before each call. Failures may be billed. Many’s model and embeddings are excluded; provider billing is authoritative.
rates_date: Reference rates reviewed {{date}}. Rates and free credits may change.
save_error: Could not save. Your edits remain here.
key_required: Add a key for every enabled paid provider.
test_hint: One explicit request within your budget. It may use a paid provider or your enabled extension tab. It does not save a note or certify every operation of the source.
test_failed: The operation could not be completed.
probe_failed: Check the route, access and provider, then retry.
import_hint: Paste authorized text. Dome saves a note with source, capture date and manual-import provenance. Partial evidence does not enable automated access.
import_error: Could not save the evidence. Your text remains here.
integration_hint: Dome adapts configuration, diagnosis and routing through native tools and its extension. Upstream installers, cookie exports and unapproved collectors are not bundled. All 16 sources accept evidence imports.
version: Reference commit {{commit}} · MIT. Updates ship with Dome after review.
upstream_hint: Reference tools are not installed or enabled here. Each has separate license and access conditions.

descriptions.web: Read public pages directly or through an explicitly enabled tab. Search with public or allowed BYOK providers.
descriptions.exa_search: Semantic search with your Exa key, permission and budget. Deep is disabled.
descriptions.rss: Read accessible RSS and Atom feeds locally. Dates and links are retained; coverage remains partial.
descriptions.github: Search public repositories and read profile/repository metadata via GitHub API. Existing authentication supplies access and quotas.
descriptions.v2ex: Upstream offers topics, replies and users via V2EX API. Import evidence while reuse conditions are reviewed.
descriptions.youtube: Upstream uses yt-dlp for video search and captions. Dome accepts authorized transcripts without bundling those executables.
descriptions.xiaoyuzhou: Podcast research and transcription. Import authorized audio or transcripts and configure transcription under AI.
descriptions.instagram: Read available public snapshots. Missing metrics stay unknown and the sample is not full history. Publishing is configured separately in Social.
descriptions.linkedin: Profiles, companies and jobs require authorized evidence or an approved provider. Login does not enable automated collection.
descriptions.x: Read available public snapshots. Upstream search/timeline CLIs do not grant general access. Publishing accounts remain separate.
descriptions.reddit: Commercial API access needs authorization. Import permitted posts and discussions; session cookies do not enable this connector.
descriptions.facebook: Page, feed and group research awaits access review. Publishing permissions do not grant research access; import evidence.
descriptions.bilibili: Upstream uses bili-cli and OpenCLI for videos and captions. Native access is pending; import authorized content.
descriptions.xiaohongshu: Search, posts and comments await review. Dome does not export cookies or automate login; import permitted evidence.
descriptions.boss: Upstream job search uses a dedicated browser session. Dome currently analyzes imported job descriptions.
descriptions.xueqiu: Research imported news and discussions. Real-time quote redistribution is not enabled.

errors.source_disabled: This source is disabled for Many.
errors.source_pending_enablement: Automated access is pending. Import authorized evidence.
errors.profile_pending_enablement: Profile access is pending. Import authorized evidence.
errors.configure_and_enable_search_provider: Add your key and enable provider usage.
errors.provider_not_enabled: This paid provider is not enabled.
errors.search_unavailable: Public search is unavailable. Keep earlier evidence and avoid repeated requests.
errors.selected_tab_required: Enable the exact target tab in the paired extension.

encryption_unavailable: OS encryption is unavailable. No new credentials were saved. Enable secure storage and retry.
saved_refresh_error: Configuration saved, but diagnosis could not refresh. Try Check configuration again.
